title: Play and leisure
learning_outcomes: Explain recreation versus productivity in the context of play and leisure.
Compare and distinguish barriers in the context of play and leisure.
Apply enjoyable options in the context of play and leisure.
Evaluate and justify decisions about reflection in the context of play and leisure.

lessons.title: Recreation versus productivity
lessons.outcome: Explain recreation versus productivity in the context of play and leisure.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving recreation versus productivity; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to leisure design portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain recreation versus productivity from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of recreation versus productivity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Barriers
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish barriers in the context of play and leisure.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving barriers; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to leisure design portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain barriers from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of barriers; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Enjoyable options
lessons.outcome: Apply enjoyable options in the context of play and leisure.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving enjoyable options; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to leisure design portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain enjoyable options from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of enjoyable options; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Reflection
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about reflection in the context of play and leisure.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving reflection; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to leisure design portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain reflection from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of reflection; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of recreation versus productivity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of barriers; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of enjoyable options; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of reflection; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
